text: Japan's Q3 GDP contracted 0.1% annualized against expected growth of 0.3%. Real final sales fell 2.1% annualized. Net exports contributed -0.6 percentage points to GDP growth amid elevated energy import costs. September core inflation stood at 2.1%.

meta.note: Annualized quarterly contraction coexists with 1.1% year-on-year GDP growth.

text: China's October retail sales rose 0.4% YoY and industrial output rose 4.8%, both below estimates. Fixed-asset investment contracted 8.1% in January-October. October exports expanded 35.2% YoY, while consumer inflation stood at 0.7%.

meta.note: Fixed-asset investment covers a cumulative ten-month period; other indicators reflect October.

text: Warren Buffett donated $5.5 billion in Berkshire Hathaway shares across four foundations through the conversion of 6,150 Class A shares into 9,225,000 Class B shares. His remaining holdings comprise 182,140 Class A shares valued at approximately $162 billion.

meta.note: The transfer concerns equity ownership rather than liquidation or grant disbursement.
